criteria.observation: Compares the commands that ran in the supplied job with the required suites and identifies which behavior each covers.
Distinguishes an omitted check from a failed run and accurately attributes CI, local and unobserved outcomes.
Follows an affected input through quote calculation to the resulting order decision using supporting evidence.
The recommendation follows the material contract and evidence. Unrelated warnings add no credit.
Gives an observable repair or verification result that would change the decision, covering both order behavior and the required gate.
